items.title: From a league source regarding Maxime Raynaud: "As part of his recovery process, Max practiced with Stockton today. He was a full participant, including 5v5. He continues to make progress towards his return to the court."
items.author: James Ham
items.body_excerpt:
From a league source regarding Maxime Raynaud: "As part of his recovery process, Max practiced with Stockton today. He was a full participant, including 5v5. He continues to make progress towards his return to the court."

Raynaud is OUT against the Warriors, but getting closer to a return.

Makes me sad cause I really liked Maxime Raynaud and Nique Clifford as potential trade down targets for the Wolves in 2025, so I thought "Wow, good job, Scott Perry!"

But I should've known.....
